settings.content: Brand palette from the Colour Language brand book. These feed CSS variables used by the custom Hartwick sections. Luxe's own Colors panel below should be pointed at these same values.

Aloha, 23 September 2026: "there should be no white on the background, please use again f3f0e7 colour throughout." Changing this one field restyles the whole site; Luxe's own background colours (Theme settings > Colors) are set to the same value.
Aloha's remade homepage: the opening and the story cards are a slightly darker sheet of paper than the page, and the sections are bound by a dark bar with binder rings.

settings.label: Paper panel
settings.info: The opening note, the tab of each story card and the translucent band it lays over the photograph.

settings.content: Grain on dark blocks — Journal, 23 September

Aloha's grain layer, as she laid it over the dark blocks of the Journal artboard: her own grain image, Normal blend. Only blocks that carry it (the Journal's dark bands and any Register band with Grain ticked) are affected; light grounds and photographs never are.

settings.label: Grain strength
settings.info: 32% = her layer on the artboard. 0 = no grain anywhere.

settings.label: Register page grain
settings.info: The Register page (Aloha, 24 September): the same grain over the whole page, the purple band and the paper alike, but not over the photographs. 0 = none on that page.

settings.content: Aloha's Register page design (21 September 2026) opens on a wine-coloured band with an envelope drawn in paper. Neither colour is one of the eight Material Archive colours; they are held here so the page follows the palette when it is finalised.

settings.label: Correspondence band
settings.info: The Register page's opening band and its two buttons, and the homepage Register band. #502F37: Angela, 24 September, keep the purple.

settings.content: Porter is a licensed commercial font supplied as desktop OTF only. Until a webfont licence is confirmed it carries Junicode. Turning this on once the licence lands is the only change needed.

settings.label: Show provisional-content notices
settings.info: The boxed PLACEHOLDER markers every section can carry. Off since 20 September 2026 (Ivan); each section's own checkbox still applies when this is on.

settings.content: Shopify delivers every contact-form submission to the store's sender address (Settings > Notifications) — that is not a theme value and cannot be set here. The address below is added to the body of each appointment enquiry as a "Route to" line, so a mail rule can forward them on, and every submission is already tagged "Enquiry type: Private appointment". Aloha is confirming the Hartwick address.

settings.label: Route appointment enquiries to
settings.info: Optional. Appears inside the enquiry email; it does not change where Shopify sends it.

settings.content: Aloha, 3 September 2026: scarcity language is removed from the whole site. Any badge whose text contains one of these phrases is dropped before it renders — on product cards, recommendations, search results and the product page — even if the tag or metafield is still set on the product in the admin. Comma separated, case-insensitive, matched on containment. A verified production quantity belongs in the Material Record as a fact, never as a badge.

settings.label: Suppressed badge phrases
settings.default: limited edition, limited-edition, limited run, exclusive, last chance, selling fast, almost gone, only a few left, hurry, final pieces

settings.content: Aloha, 4 September 2026: "the images feel oversized for the space, which makes them dominate the layout […] they shouldn't overwhelm the page." This is the ceiling every large picture on the product page obeys, measured against the height of the visitor's screen rather than in pixels so it holds on a laptop and on a large monitor alike. 56% means no single photograph can take more than a bit over half the screen.

settings.label: Largest image height
settings.info: Percentage of the screen height. 100% removes the restraint.

settings.content: Ivan, 23 September 2026: smoother scrolling and a slim scrollbar, as niccolomiranda.com. Desktop only; phones and tablets keep their own momentum, and anyone who has asked their device for reduced motion gets plain scrolling.

settings.label: Glide
settings.info: How much of the remaining distance the page travels each frame, in hundredths. Lower = longer, softer glide. 10 = the reference site.

settings.content: Aloha, 23 September 2026: her hand-drawn pencil marks on links and buttons, drawn as the visitor hovers (desktop) or taps (phone). Arrow links carry her pencil arrow; links that had the small corner mark get her double oval round their last word; the other text links and ruled buttons get one of her two loose rings. Toggles (+), close buttons, size boxes, photographs and the filled buttons are left plain.

settings.label: Pencil marks
settings.info: Off = the plain arrows and corner marks come back.

settings.label: Vary the rings
settings.info: On = each link gets one of her two rings at random, with a slight turn. Off = always her option no.1.

settings.content: Aloha, 22 September 2026: "Porter = major titles/product names. Junicode = editorial headings, Expressions, numbers and selected introductions. Noto Sans Mono Condensed = body copy, navigation, functional information, captions and data." Two of those rows move a voice, and each reverses an earlier decision of hers, so each is a switch rather than a rewrite. Both default to the 22 September table. Flagged to Aloha — if either was not intended, change it here, not in the code.

settings.label: Body copy
settings.info: The brand book gave body copy to Junicode as the NARRATE voice. The 22 September table gives it to Noto Sans Mono Condensed at 13px. This also sets the typeface of every unstyled word in the theme — the cart, the account pages, forms and the cookie banner.

settings.label: Navigation and footer
settings.info: The header and footer have run in Porter Light since Aloha's 15 September note ("footer fonts in Porter - Light"). Her 22 September table puts navigation and footer in Noto Sans Mono Condensed.

settings.content: Aloha, 22 September 2026 ("web text sizes"): "We need to heavily decrease the sizes of our texts […] I want to tighten the typography across the entire site. […] Can we establish a consistent typography system across the theme rather than adjusting sections individually? […] The overall aim is smaller and calmer. Photography, spacing and information structure should create the hierarchy rather than oversized typography." Every size on the storefront now comes from the sliders below — the Hartwick sections, the Luxe header, footer, cart, product cards and account pages alike. Nothing is set section by section any more, so moving one slider moves that text category everywhere at once. Her table is the default for every slider; a page should deviate only where there is an intentional editorial reason.

settings.label: Hero / large editorial heading
settings.info: Aloha's table gives a range of 30–34px here; 32 is its centre. This is the largest type anywhere on the site — nothing above it, by design.

settings.label: Editorial intro paragraph
settings.info: The larger Junicode paragraph that opens a section. Ordinary body copy is the row below.

settings.label: Copyright and legal
settings.info: The one 9px surface Aloha specified. It carries the copyright line and nothing else.

settings.label: Product name (Style)
settings.info: Porter. Sits one step above the editorial subheading, not on the section-title line.

settings.content: The 3 September floor ("labels and technical information never below 12px on mobile") is superseded by the 22 September table, which sets labels, captions and metadata at 10px on both breakpoints and legal text at 9px. The floor is no longer enforced in code.

settings.label: Hero / large editorial heading
settings.info: Her range is 26–30px; 28 is its centre.

settings.label: Body line height
settings.info: Aloha gave body copy a range of 1.55–1.65. The other line heights in her table are fixed per category and are set in snippets/ha-tokens.liquid.

settings.content: The Register and Circle request forms post straight to Klaviyo from the theme's own form, so they can match the design. These three values are the only Klaviyo wiring in the theme. The company ID is the public site key already in klaviyo.js — not a secret.

settings.label: Company ID (public API key)
settings.info: Klaviyo → Settings → API keys → Public API key. Six characters.

settings.label: The Register — list ID
settings.info: The list joined by every 'Join The Register' form. Double opt-in is set on the list itself.

settings.label: Circle Requests — list ID
settings.info: A separate list. Circle requests never join The Register automatically, in either direction.

settings.content: REGION / LANGUAGE / THE CIRCLE / BAG — Aloha, 22 September 2026. Four utilities in the header, each opening a quiet drawer that shares the bag's typography, rules and close control. On a phone the first three sit at the foot of the menu.

settings.label: Use the Hartwick header utilities
settings.info: Off restores Luxe's own region, language and account items (Header section settings).

settings.label: Show REGION
settings.info: The countries and currencies are Shopify Markets (Settings > Markets). The header shows the current one, e.g. ES / EUR.

settings.label: Line under the current region
settings.default: Prices, currency and delivery follow the country you choose.

settings.label: Suggest the visitor's region
settings.info: Shopify's detection offers a switch; it never changes region by itself, and the selector always stays available. "Stay" is remembered in that browser.

settings.label: Suggestion line
settings.info: [country] is replaced by the detected country.

settings.content: Shopify's native languages (Settings > Languages): each published language gets its own URL (/fr, /de) and hreflang. LANGUAGE appears on its own once a second language is published.

settings.label: Show LANGUAGE while only one language is published
Circle member customer tag
settings.info: Signing in unlocks the member space only for customers carrying this exact tag (Customers > customer > Tags). A purchase never does. Build the Circle segment on the same tag.

settings.label: Line for visitors
settings.default: A private space for members of Hartwick Atelier's Circle.

settings.label: Show MEMBER SIGN IN
settings.info: Opens Shopify's customer sign-in. There is no Create Account link anywhere in the drawer.

settings.label: Secondary link
settings.info: Empty uses the page with the handle the-circle.

settings.label: Line for signed-in customers who are not members
Member greeting
settings.info: Followed by the member's first name.

settings.label: Member links
settings.info: Circle communications, invitations, early access, the private Journal — add each here as it exists. Orders & details and Sign out are always shown.

settings.label: Empty — short line
settings.default: Pieces you add will appear here.

settings.label: Show the taxes and shipping line under the subtotal

settings.content: ⚠️ THE SIZES IN THIS GROUP NO LONGER DO ANYTHING. Aloha asked on 22 September 2026 for one typography system across the whole theme rather than sizes set section by section, so every size on the storefront — Luxe's own header, footer, cart, product cards and account pages included — is now driven from Hartwick — Material Archive > Type scale. The font pickers, letter spacing and text case below still apply; the pixel sliders are overridden. Change the type scale, not these.

settings.info: Allow customers to add a note or message with their order.
